title: Diriba breaks course record, Berhanu threatens mark at Amsterdam Marathon

story.W: Four women were together at halfway (1:08:34). Buze Diriba and Aynalem Desta dropped the others after 30 km, then Diriba kicked and won by almost a minute in a course record, with a faster second half.
story.M: A large group passed halfway in 1:02:24 behind pacemakers. Nicholas Kipkorir attacked near the Vondelpark with Lemi Berhanu; Berhanu edged clear after 40 km and missed the course record by three seconds. Eight men broke 2:05.

performances.name: Buze DIRIBA
performances.note: Course record 2:16:12, more than three minutes off her best, with a faster second half. Broke Desta after 30 km and won by almost a minute; 16th-fastest in history.

performances.name: Aynalem DESTA
performances.note: The defending champion was second in a personal best after running with Diriba until the final kick.

performances.name: Meseret BELETE
performances.note: Third in a personal best, dropped by the leading pair after 30 km.

performances.name: Lemi BERHANU
performances.note: Won in 2:03:33, a minute faster than the best he set ten years ago and three seconds off the course record. Followed Kipkorir's attack, then edged ahead after 40 km.

performances.name: Nicholas KIPKORIR
performances.note: Made the decisive attack near the Vondelpark and was shoulder to shoulder with Berhanu at 40 km before losing by six seconds. Second marathon, a best by more than two minutes.

performances.name: Patrick MOSIN
performances.note: Third in a personal best, 11 seconds behind the leaders at 40 km.

performances.name: Justus KANGOGO
performances.note: Took over the pace when the pacemakers stepped aside at 30 km and stretched the field; finished sixth.

dnf.name: Geofry Toroitich KIPCHUMBA
dnf.note: The defending champion and course record holder was eight seconds behind the leaders at halfway and dropped out shortly afterwards; no reason given.
